decisions.reason: The six-hour completion expectation does not change the fallback behavior used when assigned work is unavailable.
The source changes overall shift completion timing but does not alter artifact destinations, storage rules, or supporting-link requirements.
The instruction to finish work within the shift does not change how completed subtasks or goal parent tasks are marked in ClickUp.
The source establishes a general assignment-completion expectation and does not change Shopify publication behavior, coverage, or categorization.
The spreadsheet structure and concurrent recording rule remain unchanged by the general six-hour shift expectation.
The source does not change TikTok Shop listing methods, timing relative to the working list, product handling, or coverage.
The CRM document's required result and completion location remain unchanged; the source concerns general future shift completion.
The source does not specifically revise the content bank artifact, intended use, or its existing initial deadline.
Although the source follows Airbnb outreach instructions, it changes the overarching shift-completion expectation rather than the outreach cadence, host selection, or message method.
The general requirement to avoid unfinished work after the shift does not change product-selection criteria, source, or product-count targets.
The source does not change the required next-step guidance for interested Airbnb host conversations.
The shift-completion expectation has no necessary effect on the requirement that shared credentials be visible through Bitwarden.
